name: claude-proxy
description: Runs Claude Code workers with a live inline activity view in ChatGPT desktop.

interface.shortDescription: Use Claude Code with live worker activity.
interface.longDescription: Routes substantive tasks to Claude Code while an inline activity card shows safe live worker progress, then returns the result to Codex for verification and presentation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Claude as the worker for this task, then verify and summarize the result.
